title: What the guidance scale does
summary: How classifier-free guidance mixes conditional and unconditional predictions.

choices.text: It is the training target of flow matching. A scale above 1 turns the model into a one-step consistency model.
It switches the sampler to DDIM. The scale is the number of timesteps skipped between denoising steps.
It pushes the denoising prediction past the conditional estimate, away from the unconditional one, so samples follow the caption more closely and are usually less diverse.
It mixes in the gradient of a separately trained image classifier. The scale is that classifier's loss weight, which is why the method is classifier-free.
